title: runner watch takes the value of an interpreter option such as python3 -X claude as the script word, so a process with claude as an option value passes the claude guard and is signalled
goal: runner watch refuses with exit 2 a process whose only claude word is the value of an interpreter option, and signals nothing

run:
import subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time,pathlib as P,shutil
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); rep=P.Path(d)/"report"; rep.write_text("")
p=s.Popen([sys.executable,"-X","claude","-c","import time;time.sleep(30)"])
time.sleep(1)
w=s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","runner","watch","--pid",str(p.pid),"--report",str(rep),"--stale","0.5"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
time.sleep(0.5); alive=p.poll() is None
p.kill(); p.wait(); shutil.rmtree(d)
print("rc",w.returncode,"alive",alive,w.stdout.strip(),w.stderr.strip())
sys.exit(0 if w.returncode==2 and alive else 1)
